## Question

State one focused question.

## Data and method

Describe the dataset, sample size, variables, quality controls, and statistical method. Link to the corresponding [R workflow](../workflows/index.qmd).

## Result

Report estimates and uncertainty, not only statistical significance. Include a clear figure or table when useful.

## Interpretation and limitations

Separate what the analysis shows from possible biological explanations. Note confounding, selection, measurement, and multiple-testing limitations.

## Review status

**Draft — not for citation.** Reviewed by: _name and date_.
